A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have established the Green's function theory for second-order elliptics in divergence form in the two-dimensional setting.

we have established the Green's function for second-order uniformly elliptic equations in divergence form when the coefficients satisfy the standard Dini condition, and the domain has Lipschitz boundary.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Dini condition is sufficient for the existence of a Green's function.
the Green function can be bounded in terms of the coefficients of the equation, the domain, and the distance from the boundary, without any reference to the distance to the singular point.
the Green function can be constructed for a much wider range of coefficients than previously known.
